title: 📋 Admin Panel - Update 12.15.2025
body:
🛒 NEW: Complete Checkout & Order Management System
Customer Shopping Experience
15-Minute Reservation System:

When customers proceed to checkout, their selected items are reserved for 15 minutes
Visual countdown timer shows remaining time with color-coded warnings (green → yellow → red)
5-minute early warning notification to complete purchase
If time expires, items are automatically released back to inventory
Streamlined Checkout Process:

Complete order form with shipping and billing address
Multiple payment options: Card, Cash on Delivery, Store Credit
Real-time order summary with totals, tax, and shipping
Beautiful order confirmation page with order number
Order history where customers can view all past orders
Detailed order tracking with status timeline
Admin Order Management Dashboard
Comprehensive Order Management:

Complete orders dashboard with real-time statistics cards:
Total Orders, Pending, Processing, Completed
Total Revenue, Today's Orders, Today's Revenue, Cancelled orders
Advanced search and filtering:
Search by order number
Filter by status (Pending, Confirmed, Processing, Ready, Completed, Cancelled)
Date range picker for custom date ranges
Filter by store location
Filter by payment method
Filter by order amount (min/max range)
Active filter chips show all applied filters with individual remove buttons
Pagination for large order lists
Order Detail View:

Complete order information in a responsive dialog
Visual 5-step status timeline showing order progress
Quick status update buttons with loading states
Line items with product images, colors, sizes, quantities, and pricing
Payment information with status badges
Shipping and billing addresses
Admin-Only Order Cancellation:
Requires cancellation reason (minimum 10 characters)
Records cancellation timestamp
Automatically returns stock to inventory
Customers can only delete incomplete PENDING orders

📦 NEW: Advanced Inventory & Stock Management
Real-Time Stock Tracking
Product Variants System:

Full color and size combination tracking (e.g., Red/Small, Blue/Large)
Stock levels tracked per variant per store location
Reserved stock shown separately (items in active checkouts)
Available stock calculated automatically (on hand - reserved)
Stock Overview Dashboard:

Grouped, expandable view showing stock by Item + Location
Parent rows show aggregated totals across all variants
Expand to see individual color/size variant details
Status indicators: OK (green), LOW (orange), OUT (red)
Expand All/Collapse All toggle for quick navigation
Sortable columns for easy organization
50 items per page with pagination
Stock Management Features:

Add, subtract, or set exact stock quantities
Require reason for all stock adjustments (audit trail)
Complete stock history viewer per variant
Low stock threshold alerts (customizable per product)
Bulk variant creation dialog (add multiple color/size combinations at once)
Low Stock Alert System
Real-Time Notifications:

Bell icon in admin panel header shows unread alert count
Dropdown panel displays recent alerts grouped by location
Configurable thresholds via settings dialog:
Low stock threshold (default: 10 units)
Critical stock threshold (default: 0 units = out of stock)
"Mark all read" and refresh buttons
Auto-streams new alerts in real-time
Low Stock Alerts Tab:

Dedicated tab showing all low/out-of-stock items
Organized by store location for easy restocking
Direct access to stock adjustment from alerts

🔍 Enhanced Filtering & Search
Products Table
Advanced Search:

Search across multiple fields simultaneously:
Product name, price, category, subcategory, location, tags
Multi-location filter with checkbox dialog
"No Locations Assigned" quick filter
"Missing Specific Locations" filter
Active filter chips with individual remove buttons
"Clear All Filters" option
Orders Table
Comprehensive Filters:

Date range picker for custom periods
Store location filter
Payment method filter
Amount range (min/max)
Order status filter
Search by order number
All filters shown as removable chips

title: 📱 Mobile App Updates Part 2
body:
🏠 Home Page - Quick Access Section
Admin-Controlled Categories:

The Quick Access section on the home page is now fully controlled from the admin panel
Categories you mark as "Quick Access" will automatically appear here
Display order matches the order you set in the admin panel
Changes sync in real-time—no app restart needed
📍 Multi-Location Support (NEW!)
Products can now be assigned to multiple store locations, and the app handles this intelligently:

Location Display on Product Details:

Online Only - If a product has no physical store locations, a blue "Online Only" tag is displayed
Single Location - If available at one store, the location name is shown
Multiple Locations - If available at multiple stores, users see a dropdown to select their preferred pickup location
This prepares the app for future features like location-based inventory and store pickup options.

📂 Category Pages - Image Support
Custom Category Images:

Category pages now display the custom images uploaded through the admin panel
Supports both standard images and base64 encoded images
Images load smoothly with caching to prevent flickering
⚡ Performance & Stability
Real-Time Updates:

The app now receives live updates when inventory or categories change
No need to pull-to-refresh—new products and category changes appear automatically
Image Performance:

Added image caching to prevent repeated loading
Smooth transitions when images load (no more flickering)

Note: All data in the videos are test data for testing pure functionality
Please review the release notes section to see the part 1 post.

title: 📋 PINK Boutique - Development Update [ November 26 - December 1, 2025 ]
body:
🔧 Admin Panel Updates
🏠 Quick Access Section Control (NEW!)
A powerful new feature has been added to manage the Quick Access section on the mobile app's home page directly from the admin panel.

What You Can Do:

Toggle Quick Access visibility - Choose which categories appear in the Quick Access section on the home page
Custom ordering - Set the display order so your most important categories appear first
Custom images - Upload a separate image for Quick Access cards, or use the main category image as default
Real-time updates - Changes made in the admin panel are instantly reflected on users' home screens
Visual Indicator:

Categories enabled for Quick Access now display a small "Quick" badge in the top-left corner of their card in the category management panel, making it easy to see at a glance which categories are featured
🔍 Enhanced Search & Filtering
The inventory table search has been significantly upgraded:

Multi-Field Search:

Search now scans across multiple fields simultaneously:
Product name
Price
Category & Subcategory
Store location
Tags
New Location Filters:

Multi-location filter - Select multiple store locations to filter by
"No Locations Assigned" filter - Quickly find items that haven't been assigned to any store location
"Missing Specific Locations" filter - Find items missing from particular stores
Active Filter Chips:

All active filters are now displayed as visual chips at the top of the table
Each filter chip has its own remove button for quick deselection
Location filters show each selected location separately for precise control
📦 Bulk Category Assignment Improvements
Independent Subcategory Updates:

You can now update only the subcategory for multiple items without changing the main category
Previously, bulk editing required selecting a main category first
Dark Theme Fixes:

The bulk category assignment dialog now fully supports dark mode
All dropdowns, checkboxes, and text elements properly respect your theme preference
📂 Category Management Enhancements
Two-Column Layout:

Quick Access settings are now organized in a cleaner two-column layout within the edit dialog
Image Handling Improvements:

Image previews now fit properly within their containers (no more awkward cropping)
Remove button for Quick Access images works correctly for both new and existing images
Image uploads now reliably persist when saving
Category Image Upload:

Upload custom images for categories directly through the admin panel
Supports both standard image files and base64 encoded images
🎨 Visual & Theme Updates
Dark/Light Theme Toggle:

Full dark mode support throughout the admin panel
Theme preference is remembered across sessions
Shimmer Loading Effects:

Elegant loading animations have been added to the dashboard
Skeleton loaders appear while data is being fetched, providing a smoother visual experience
Responsive Dialogs:

All dialog windows (Edit Item, Create Item, Category Assignment, etc.) are now responsive
Dialogs automatically adjust their size based on your screen dimensions
Works seamlessly on different monitor sizes
⚡ Performance Improvements
Real-Time Streaming:

Category changes made in the admin panel now broadcast instantly to all connected mobile apps
No need for users to refresh—updates appear automatically

title: 📌 PINK - Nov 24th, 2025 — Admin Panel. Shop and Favorites tabs
body:
🔧 Admin Panel Updates

Visual Changes
This week’s updates focused primarily on backend improvements within the admin panel.
The Inventory Management section is currently the main priority, as it will be the central hub for managing stock and product details.

🗂 Stock Count Dialog

A simple but informative dialog has been added, allowing you to quickly view the total number of inventory items currently in stock.
Future improvement:
This dialog may be relocated to a less intrusive spot—likely the bottom-left area of the table—for improved usability.


🔍 Search & Quick Filter Enhancements

A new search function has been added, allowing you to filter inventory items by name, price, or status.
Additionally, a Quick Filter dropdown has been introduced for fast, preset filtering options such as:
Active items
Inactive items

Future improvement:
More quick filter options will be added to improve convenience and speed when browsing inventory.

🎨 Updated Icons
New icons have been added to various table columns to improve visual clarity and help present data in a more intuitive way.

⚙️ Performance Improvements
Table Performance Optimization
Several backend performance adjustments were made to ensure the inventory table loads smoothly, especially when scrolling through large sets of data.

📄 Future Pagination Update

To further enhance performance, the inventory table will soon be updated with pagination, loading only 20–50 items per page. This will reduce load time and make navigation smoother.

Global Filtering Behavior:
Even with pagination, the search filter will operate globally.
For example, if an item exists on page 5 and you search its name, the system will:

Clear the current table view
Display only the matching filtered results
This ensures you can always find specific items instantly, no matter which page they’re on.

📱 Frontend Updates — Shop & Favorites Enhancements

This week includes two major additions on the frontend of the mobile app:
NEW! Shop tab + full browsing flow
NEW! Favorites tab with Boards functionality
NEW! Status Indicator banners for connection and server health

🛒 Shop Tab

The entire Shop experience—both design and functionality—has now been built out.
Please refer to the updated screenshots for a visual overview of the features described below.

🔎 Search Bar

A search bar is placed at the top of the Shop screen for quick access when users want to find a specific product.
Note: Search functionality is not yet completed.

📂 Category Section

The category section displays a grid view of all major store categories, each with a thumbnail and category name. This helps users quickly identify the types of products available.

➡️ Category Pages

Each category icon is clickable.
Selecting a category takes the user to that category’s dedicated shop page.
This page includes dynamic filtering, allowing users to narrow down item types or styles within that category.

🎯 Filter Bubbles

Filter bubbles act as a second layer of filtering for more precise browsing.
When entering a category page, the default filter is “All”, showing all items within that category.
Example: Entering the Tops category initially displays all tops.
Selecting a specific filter bubble (e.g., Blouses) updates the inventory list instantly to show only items within that filter.
Note: These filter pages are not fully implemented yet. Development will continue in the coming days, and an update will follow once completed.

📜 Browse Section

Below the category and filter area, users will find an infinite scrolling list of all store items—perfect for shoppers who prefer to browse the full catalog.
Additional features include:
Visual tags for Hot, New in Stock, and Sale items
Clickable product cards that open the Product Details Page, where users can view more information and add items to their bag

❤️ Favorites Tab

The Favorites tab is now fully implemented and includes an advanced organizational feature: Boards.

⭐ Favorites List

The main view displays every item the user has marked as a favorite.
Users can swipe an item card to the left to reveal two quick actions:
Remove the item from Favorites
Add the item to a Board

📌 Boards

Boards are a powerful organizational feature added to make Favorites more flexible and user-friendly.
Each user can:

Create any number of boards
   -Add their favorite items to any board
   -Add a custom description to each board
   -Remove items individually from a board
   -Delete an entire board if desired
Boards allow shoppers to:
   -Pre-save items they’re considering for future purchase
   -Watch for restocks
   -Organize favorites into categories like “Gift Ideas,” “Work Outfits,” or “Wish List”

📶 New Feature: Status Indicator Banners
A new connection-awareness system has been added to improve clarity and user experience when connectivity issues occur.
🟠 Server Disconnected Banner
If the app is unable to connect to your server, an orange banner appears at the bottom of the screen notifying the user of the issue.
🔴 No Internet Banner
If the user’s device loses internet access, a second banner appears informing them of the network outage.
🟢 Connection Restored Banner
When connectivity returns—either Internet or server-related—a green “Connection Restored” banner is displayed for a few seconds to reassure the user that functionality is back to normal.

This system ensures the app always communicates clearly with the user when something affects performance or loading reliability.

[Please review the Screenshots page to see all updated screenshots showing the changes mentioned in this update notes]

title: Project Update - PINK - Nov 14th 2025
body:
Executive Summary

We’ve made the app faster, more stable, and more interactive. Ads and Home sections (Sale, New, Hot) now update in real-time. Admin controls are improved, and documentation/release notes are up to date. Next, we’ll start building the payment system.

Highlights Delivered

Real-time Data
Ads and Home sections now update automatically—no manual refresh needed.
Only changes are sent to the app to save data and improve speed.
Admin Controls
Items can be marked as Sale, New, or Hot (one category per item).
Changes made by admins update instantly for all users.

Performance & Stability

Smoother scrolling and swiping.
Images load faster using caching and preloading.
Fixed minor bugs that could cause crashes.
Reduced unnecessary network calls.

Offline Readiness
Cached items, sizes, and colors allow the app to start faster and work better with poor internet.

Documentation & Release
Real-time Home sections integration guide added.
Server playbook and release notes updated (v2.2.0).

What’s Next
Monitor swipe performance and tweak layouts if needed.
Start payment system setup with a secure server-first approach.
Only call third-party APIs from the client if necessary.

Please review the "Screenshots section to see all up-to-date screenshots of the project"
